enterableInventory.completenessArgument: The enterable inventory is closed by the Reference Build's own entry dispatch: a single immediate comparison bounds the accepted slot range and every larger slot index takes the reject branch before any state is read, so no reachable input can enter an object outside the enumerated set. Each accepted slot selects one fixed-length parameter block, and the block is copied verbatim into the live block that the locomotion handler is dispatched through, so the slot-to-block relation is total and single-valued. The class key is the projection of that block onto the offsets consumed by action-surface, rate-limit and PAL-timing code; the single offset consumed by no dispatched handler is excluded as inert. Because every enumerated slot projects to a distinct key, the partition is currently singleton: no coarser partition is provable until specific rate magnitudes are shown inert to UNC-0001's responsibilities. The dispatch handler count records the coarsest partition that the dispatch structure alone would support.
